title: Outer three-quarter view
prompt:
USER DESIGN OVERRIDE: retain the compact industrial design in the reference, but CHANGE cable routing to a lower-exit, cable-down configuration. Cable exits the BOTTOM of each earbud and falls below it. No cable over the ear, no upper cable loop, no top cable port. This override takes priority over the reference pixels.
Use case: product-mockup.
Input image: the supplied multi-panel concept board is the AUTHORITATIVE product design reference. Match its compact premium in-ear monitor form, not a larger disk-shaped previous design. Use the top-left panel for the complete system, the top-right and bottom-right panels for ear-facing geometry, and bottom-left only for natural ear fit; ignore its over-ear cable routing.
Product identity invariants: compact rounded teardrop/oval shell; smooth subtly domed satin-black outer faceplate with a very thin warm gunmetal/champagne rim (NO radial brushed disc); dark smoked translucent acoustic housing with restrained glimpses of internal structure; short inward-facing acoustic nozzle with a replaceable soft grey silicone tip; a small flexible dark concha wing forming an upper curved hook-like fin integrated into the inner shell; EXACTLY TWO flush pale champagne oval taVNS electrodes located together on the EAR-FACING INNER wing/pad, NOT a metal pad on the extreme tip of the fin. A separate small recessed black-glass rectangular PPG window sits on the ear-facing shell beside the nozzle, containing subtle optical elements; keep this separate from the acoustic bore. Dry EEG electrodes are a segmented conductive collar around the NOZZLE/TIP INTERFACE, not black patches on the outside of the silicone tip. Black braided cable exits the BOTTOM of the shell through a short downward-pointing dark strain relief and falls naturally below the ear. There is NO over-ear loop and NO top cable connector. The inline controller is a slim rounded charcoal rectangular bar with minus, center and plus buttons and one tiny status light. Its upstream connection is USB-C.
Style and production: exceptionally detailed, photorealistic industrial-design visualization, refined studio product photography. Warm light-grey seamless background and very subtle soft contact shadows, matching the supplied reference; satin dark metals, softly translucent shell, fine silicone grain and braided cable detail. Soft large studio lights, realistic reflections, no heavy bloom. Focus-stacked macro sharpness with mild telephoto perspective. Generous margins. Prefer native 2048x1536 or higher detail, landscape 4:3. No text, no branding printed on hardware, no watermarks, no labels, no split panels. Render real dimensional geometry from the requested viewpoint; never paste/crop/rotate the board. Avoid extra controls, giant rigid fins, overlarge earpieces, wireless charging cases, exposed cartoon circuits and invented numerical specifications.
Composition: ONE complete earbud seen from the OUTER face in a low three-quarter view. Smooth oval dark faceplate is dominant, thin champagne edge, smoked housing reveals gentle depth behind it. Ear tip projects behind toward the right, attached to inward nozzle. Short downward-facing cable connector on the BOTTOM of the shell, with braided cable falling below the product. No cable connector or loop at the top. The soft concha wing is partially visible behind the housing. Earbud fills 65 percent of frame, all edges in frame. Do not flatten the housing into a circle or add a brushed-metal disc.
Image 2 is the newly generated whole-system design with the correct LOWER cable exits. Use it to lock the compact earbud shape, material finish, inner sensor/contact layout and downward cable routing consistently across this set.
notes: Outer view does not expose EEG/PPG interfaces; retained after internal-interface corrections.
